lastCompletedStory.title: Regression test: cam next writes active:true and pushes no task prompt

nextStoryContext: US-002 added two discriminating regression tests to test/next.test.ts: 'runNext writes active:true on the hit path' (asserts .claude/cam-loop.local.md contains 'active: true' after runNext) and 'runNext pushes no task-prompt send-keys to the orchestrator pane' (asserts spawnFn.calls has no send-keys entry). Both tests use the existing makeFakeTmuxSpawn helper. All 1370 tests pass. No source changes; test-only story.
